Proactif(-ive) dans vos relations avec les interlocuteurs. Vous adorez être sur le terrain et vous êtes impliqué(e) dans tout ce qui est opérationnel dans votre périmètre. Centré sur le client : être obsédé par nos clients. Utiliser des données quantitatives et qualitatives pour construire un service qui soit opérationnellement excellent pour nos clients. Jouer en équipe : un joueur d'équipe qui collabore et qui est capable de tirer le meilleur parti des personnes qui vous entourent. Capable de travailler efficacement à tous les niveaux de Deliveroo et de réussir avec et par les autres. Optimiste, confiant et plein d'énergie : vous apportez de la fraîcheur, de l'énergie et de la passion dans l'équipe. Vous contribuez à créer un environnement de travail unique, propice aux nouvelles idées et agréable pour les autres personnes impliquées. Langues : Français et Anglais courant indispensables. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Nous sommes des passionnés de food, des problem-solvers, des créateurs de communauté et bien plus encore. Ce qui nous rassemble : un esprit entrepreneurial fort et l'envie de construire quelque chose d'ambitieux ensemble. 🔧 Une grande autonomie pour avoir un impact concret sur votre portefeuille et nos partenaires. 🌱 Un environnement stimulant favorisant l'apprentissage, le développement et l'évolution de carrière. 💙 Des avantages pensés pour le bien-être et l'équilibre de nos équipes. 🌍 Une culture inclusive, internationale et collaborative où chacun peut trouver sa place. ANINE BING is looking for an Accounting Manager to join our Finance team based in Paris.

This role is an opportunity to help shape the next chapter of ANINE BING. As a key contributor within our Paris HQ team, the Accounting Manager brings both strategic insight and hands-on execution to their work — supporting our global growth while staying grounded in the brand's DNA: refined, fast-moving, and always evolving.

We're looking for a senior, hands-on accounting professional who thrives in a creative yet performance-driven environment. The ideal candidate combines strong technical accounting expertise with a project management mindset, a genuine sensitivity to Finance × IT topics (AP automation, ERP improvements), and a structured, team-oriented approach. They are rigorous, organized, and energized by leading a team and building scalable accounting processes across an international footprint.

Reporting to the Global Accounting Director, the Accounting Manager owns the day-to-day accounts payable and general accounting operations across our directly-managed entities — France, the UK, the US and other EU markets. The role manages a team of three (AP Accountant, General Accountant, and Intern) and acts as the operational anchor of the accounting team, ensuring clean books, timely closes and strong vendor relationships. The role is expected to operate as a true business partner to all operational departments, not as a back-office function.

This is a hybrid position based at our Paris HQ, with one remote day per week (Wednesday or Friday). The role reports to the Accounting & Tax Director.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Own the end-to-end accounts payable process across all directly-managed entities: vendor onboarding, invoice processing, payment runs, expense reports, and vendor relationship management.
  • Lead the general accounting operations: journal entries, bank reconciliations, fixed assets, accruals, prepayments, and intercompany bookings — ensuring accurate, timely month-end and year-end closes.
  • Manage and develop a team of three (AP Accountant, General Accountant, Intern): set priorities, coach, review work and build technical depth within the team.
  • Partner with the Accounting & Tax Director on the design and implementation of accounting policies, internal controls and process improvements.
  • Lead Finance × IT initiatives within scope: AP automation tools, ERP improvements, expense management systems and approval workflows.
  • Support statutory audits and tax filings by preparing required schedules, reconciliations and supporting documentation across entities.
  • Act as a true business partner to Operations, Procurement, Retail and HQ teams — building trust, anticipating needs and ensuring smooth vendor management.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in accounting, including at least 2 years managing a team of accountants in an international, multi-entity environment.
  • Senior profile with a strong hands-on mindset: comfortable balancing managerial responsibilities with direct, detailed accounting work.
  • Strong technical command of French GAAP; exposure to US GAAP or IFRS is a plus.
  • Solid hands-on expertise across AP and general accounting: full close cycle, reconciliations, intercompany, accruals.
  • Proven project management mindset and Finance × IT sensitivity: experience leading process and system improvements (ERP rollouts, AP automation, expense management tools).
  • Genuine business partner mindset, with the ability to engage and collaborate effectively with all operational departments.
  • Proven people management skills — including hiring, coaching, and developing junior accountants and interns.
  • Fluent English required; French is a strong asset. Comfortable operating across time zones, including with US-based teams.
  • Experience in retail, fashion, e-commerce or consumer goods is a strong plus.

Benefits & Perks

  • HQ FRANCE: At ANINE BING Paris, we combine creative ambition with a people-first culture. Expect generous time off (including RTT), a hybrid schedule with one remote day per week, exclusive discounts on our collections, and private sales access — so you can live the brand as much as you build it.
  • Style Perks: Enjoy a generous employee discount and seasonal wardrobe allotments — so you can live the brand, not just represent it.
  • Performance Bonus: Eligibility for an annual performance bonus of 10% of base salary, tied to close quality, process improvements and team development.

The target gross annual base salary for this role is between €70,000 and €85,000, depending on experience, with eligibility for an annual performance bonus of 10%.

Working at ANINE BING

ANINE BING seeks to empower its employees by providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. Diversity and inclusion is critical to our success as a global brand, and we seek to recruit, develop, and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool.

More about ANINE BING

ANINE BING is a Los Angeles-based fashion house founded in 2012 that blends elements of Scandinavian simplicity with American energy to offer modern wardrobe essentials for women seeking a timeless yet rebellious approach to everyday style. Since its launch, ANINE BING has evolved into a global brand, available in over 90 countries with a growing network of brick-and-mortar retail stores in key cities worldwide.

Powered by a global team of over 250 employees, ANINE BING is headquartered in Los Angeles and Paris, with additional offices in New York and Shanghai.

About Our Paris HQ

Located just off the Champs-Élysées, our Paris headquarters at 1 Rue François 1er is a cornerstone of our international growth. As the home of our Product teams and other key functions, this space reflects our commitment to creativity, collaboration, and global perspective. As we continue to grow across Europe, our Paris office plays a central role in shaping the future of our brand.

description: Welcome to TEAM XALT Wir sind XALT – Atlassian Platinum Solution Partner mit 100 % DevSecOps-DNA. Seit 2016 realisieren wir Enterprise-Projekte in den Bereichen ITSM, Social Intranets, Cloud-Infrastruktur und Identity Management und schaffen sichere, skalierbare und moderne Kollaborationsumgebungen – auch dort, wo Regulatorik und Informationssicherheit jedes Detail mitentscheiden. Zu unseren Kunden zählen Finanzmarktinfrastrukturen und große Enterprise-Organisationen in ganz Deutschland. Wir glauben an Freiheit statt Mikromanagement, an Zusammenarbeit statt Hierarchiedenken und an Wirkung statt Titel. Bei uns übernehmen Menschen Verantwortung, bringen ihre Ideen ein und gestalten sowohl Kundenlösungen als auch die Weiterentwicklung von XALT aktiv mit. Wenn du echte Verantwortung und spürbaren Impact in einer wachsenden Beratung suchst, wirst du dich bei uns wohlfühlen. Warum gerade jetzt Atlassian stellt seine Data-Center-Produkte ein. Für Banken heißt das: Jira, Confluence und Jira Service Management müssen in die Cloud – als IT-Auslagerung unter DORA, MaRisk und EBA-Leitlinien, die vor Revision und Aufsicht bestehen muss. Genau diese Projekte machen wir. Und dafür suchen wir Verstärkung. Aufgaben Als Atlassian Consultant begleitest du Banken und Finanzdienstleister von der Plattformstrategie bis zum Go-live in der Cloud. Du verbindest Beratungsstärke mit Hands-on-Mentalität: Heute sprichst du mit CIO und CISO über das Zielbild, morgen mit dem Auslagerungsmanagement über die Exit-Strategie – und übermorgen konfigurierst du selbst das Berechtigungsschema. Deine Aufgaben Plattformstrategie: Du analysierst gewachsene Atlassian-Landschaften und entwickelst Zielbilder – Cloud vs. Hybrid, Instanzschnitt, Mandantentrennung, Governance- und Berechtigungskonzepte, Roadmap. Regulatorisch saubere Migration: Du bereitest Migrationen so auf, dass Informationssicherheit, Auslagerungsmanagement, Compliance und Datenschutz sie freigeben können – inkl. Risikoanalyse, Exit-Strategie, DORA-Informationsregister, Prüfrechte und Subdienstleister. Security & Compliance in der Cloud: Du setzt EU-Datenresidenz, SSO/SCIM mit Atlassian Guard, Audit-Logging, Verschlüsselungskonzepte, Rollentrennung (SoD) und Berechtigungsrezertifizierung um. Migrationsplanung & -durchführung: Cloud-Readiness-Assessment, App-Analyse und -Bereinigung, Wellen- und Cutover-Planung, Migration mit JCMA/CCMA – im Takt von Change-Freeze-Zeiten und Vier-Augen-Prinzip der Bank. Prüfungsfeste Dokumentation: Migrationsprotokolle, Datenintegritätsnachweise und Berechtigungskonzepte für Revision und Aufsicht. Beratung auf Augenhöhe: Du moderierst Workshops mit Entscheidern und Kontrollfunktionen und übersetzt technische Optionen in fundierte Entscheidungsvorlagen. Best Practices: Du entwickelst unsere Migrationsplaybooks für regulierte Kunden weiter und machst das Team damit skalierbar. Qualifikation Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Atlassian-Beratung oder -Administration im Enterprise-Umfeld. Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit mindestens einer komplexen Server-/Data-Center-→-Cloud-Migration. Projekterfahrung im Banking bzw. in der Finanzbranche – oder in einem vergleichbar regulierten Umfeld. Solides Verständnis von DORA, MaRisk/BAIT, EBA-Leitlinien zu Auslagerungen und DSGVO. Du musst kein Jurist sein, aber die Fragen der Compliance-Abteilung beantworten können. Fundierte Kenntnisse in Jira, Confluence und Jira Service Management, idealerweise auch Atlassian Cloud Enterprise und Atlassian Guard. Hands-on-Mentalität: Du konfigurierst selbst und wartest nicht darauf, dass jemand anderes die Umsetzung übernimmt. Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Ein Plus: Atlassian-Zertifizierungen (oder die Motivation, diese zu erwerben), Erfahrung mit ISO 27001 oder IT-Revisionen, ITIL/ITSM, Scripting (Groovy, Python, REST). Benefits Ein unbefristeter Vertrag mit langfristiger Perspektive. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und hybrides Arbeiten – mit Büros in München und Leipzig. Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen (AI, ITIL, ACP, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes und mehr). Moderne Ausstattung nach deinen Präferenzen (MacBook oder Windows). Als Platinum Partner tiefe Atlassian-Expertise im Haus – für jedes Spezialthema hast du Kolleg:innen an deiner Seite. Ein AI-first-Umfeld, in dem neue Arbeitsweisen nicht nur diskutiert, sondern gelebt werden. Flache Hierarchien und echte Verantwortung. Keine starre Rolle, in die du hineingepresst wirst – du gestaltest deine Verantwortung nach deinen Stärken und baust unser Banking-Geschäft aktiv mit auf. Freie Wahl der (AI-) Tools, die du in deinem Arbeitsalltag benötigst Klingt nach deinen Skills und deiner Perspektive für einen nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns auf darauf, dich kennenzulernen und gemeinsam die Zukunft der Zusammenarbeit zu gestalten. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: ABOUT US METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. By connecting buyers and sellers of scrap metal globally, we enable efficient trade of secondary metals and drive the seamless flow of recycling material, essential for reducing CO2 emissions by up to 95% compared to primary metal production. And we take it further! We are pioneering an innovative Smart Sorting Facility that leverages AI, machine learning, and robotics to transform how scrap metal is processed, enhance material quality, improve traceability, and drive the recycling industry into the digital era. Join us at the early stage in bringing the $610 billion scrap metal trading industry into the 21st century and in shaping the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions. READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT? If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer. The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own. We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers. Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future. YOUR MISSION PLC & Plant Control: Design, write, and own the PLC program using Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500, including control logic, sequencing, fault handling, and HMI Commissioning & Production: Take the plant from design through commissioning to a stable, running line, owning the full journey through FAT/SAT and the hands-on work required to make the plant genuinely reliable Plant Availability: Design stop and interlock behaviour to minimise unnecessary downtime — allowing unaffected parts of the plant to keep running when it is safe to do so. Plant availability is a direct business outcome here, and you will directly influence it Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary YOUR PROFILE 5+ years of hands-on experience programming and commissioning industrial control systems, with a track record of bringing production equipment or complete lines into stable operation Deep Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500 experience, with strong skills in SCL, LAD/FBD, HMI/SCADA, industrial networking (PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP), drives/VFDs, and fault-finding Strong machine safety competence, including F-CPU / Safety Integrated and EN ISO 13849, with the ability to explain and defend performance-level determinations Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient Experience working with machine and panel builders, with the confidence to hold suppliers accountable for code quality, documentation, standards compliance, and professional delivery Experience with brownfield projects and legacy migration (STEP 7 Classic → TIA); experience in bulk material handling, recycling, sorting, or minerals processing is a plus Experience with PLC version control, simulation / digital twins, or structured automation approaches is desirable. Additional IT/OT skills such as Python, C#/TIA Openness, SQL, Linux, Docker, MES/IIoT, OT network segmentation, or IEC 62443 are a plus Independent, structured, and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership. You challenge assumptions, hold suppliers to a high standard, and document what you build Fluent in English; German and/or Dutch is a plus. Ideally based in or near Cologne or the Benelux/border region, with valid EU work authorisation and the willingness to travel to our Smart Sorting Facility in Belgium, Maasmechelen WHY JOIN US? You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with a significant impact You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage We offer a competitive salary including virtual company shares We offer an environment with flat hierarchies and a steep learning curve with exciting growth opportunities You will benefit from flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely or from a shared office location We promote an inclusive, diverse and supportive work environment CONTACT Discover more about METYCLE: About us | LinkedIn We look forward to receiving your application. Irene Prinz is happy to answer any questions you may have: +49 152 34 62 72 85. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description:
Mission Brief 

The Chief Quality Inspector is the independent authority responsible for defining how product conformity is verified across manufacturing operations. This role establishes inspection strategies, verification methods, conformity assessment criteria, and competency standards to ensure objective evidence exists that every product meets defined requirements.

The position is driving a quality-at-source culture and a scalable inspection framework capable of supporting company growth. The Chief Quality Inspector ensures inspection activities provide reliable product acceptance decisions and robust evidence of compliance throughout the manufacturing lifecycle.

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Define and govern the company inspection strategy, acceptance approaches, and verification methodologies.
  • Establish conformity assessment criteria and ensure objective evidence supports all product acceptance decisions.
  • Own inspection governance, standards, procedures, and inspection-related competency frameworks.
  • Lead laboratory functions including material testing, metallography, composite testing, calibration activities, and failure investigations.
  • Support process qualification activities by defining required verification and inspection evidence.
  • Drive implementation of quality-at-source principles across manufacturing operations.
  • Ensure inspection resources, technologies, and capabilities can scale with future production demand.
  • Develop and maintain inspector training, qualification, certification, and recertification requirements.
  • Partner with Manufacturing, Production Engineering, Product Assurance, and Supplier Quality to resolve conformity concerns and improve product quality.
  • Provide clear conformity recommendations and inspection performance reporting to senior leadership.

Qualification Checklist 

  • Extensive experience in manufacturing quality, inspection, product assurance, or quality engineering leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated expertise in inspection methods, conformity assessment, acceptance criteria, and verification planning.
  • Strong understanding of incoming inspection, in-process inspection, final inspection, and release processes.
  • Experience leading NDT disciplines including X-Ray, Computed Tomography (CT), Ultrasonic, and Dye Penetrant inspection.

Reports to: VP of Engineering

Please note we can hire you in the following locations; UK, Germany, France, Belgium, Austria, Netherlands, Spain, and Finland

💼 About the role

PQShield is looking for a Director of Software Engineering to lead the development of next-generation software products and architectures tailored for Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC).

In this leadership role, you will oversee the design, development, and optimisation of software solutions that secure and accelerate PQC algorithms, providing scalable and efficient cryptographic IP for software libraries and secure communication protocols.

As part of the Engineering leadership team, you will work closely with cross-functional groups, including cryptographers, hardware engineers, product managers, and external partners, to bring innovative PQC software solutions to market.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software development, cryptography, and secure product development, with a focus on delivering secure, high-performance, and efficient products.

We have been established since 2018, so you would be directly working with the founders and inventors of this deep tech startup. The technology is already a couple of years in the making, its feasibility having been established, funding secured, and it has a clear path to market. This is a great opportunity for career progression and to get a head start in a rapidly expanding segment of the technology industry.

⚒️ What you’ll be doing

Leadership & Strategy:

  • Define and execute the software engineering strategy, aligning with the company’s overall PQC product roadmap.
  • Lead and mentor a team of software engineers, developers, and software security experts, fostering a culture of innovation and technical excellence.
  • Champion and continuously refine Agile development processes (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) to improve team velocity, predictability, and product quality.
  • Stay informed about trends in post-quantum cryptography and its software implementations to ensure competitive positioning and forward-thinking solutions.

Software Development & Architecture:

  • Oversee the design and implementation of cryptographic software libraries, secure protocols, and secure IP blocks optimised for PQC algorithms.
  • Drive the design and integration of software for use cases such as secure key management, secure communication protocols, and cryptographic agility.
  • Ensure the software architecture supports scalable and high-performance designs suitable for embedded systems, mobile, cloud, and data centre applications.

Project Management & Process:

  • Support the execution of software projects using Agile methodologies, overseeing sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to ensure predictable delivery.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams, including cryptographers, hardware engineers, and external vendors to ensure seamless integration of software and cryptography solutions.
  • Implement and enhance rigorous testing and verification methodologies, including a robust CI/CD pipeline for automated testing, integration, and deployment.

Collaboration & Communication:

  • Work closely with the hardware and cryptography teams to ensure hardware-software co-design, ensuring that software products fully leverage the latest PQC hardware accelerators.
  • Engage with external stakeholders, including open-source communities and enterprise customers, to manage the integration and deployment of PQC software IP.
  • Communicate technical concepts and development progress to executives, product management, and customers in a clear and actionable way.

Security & Compliance:

  • Ensure all software products meet the latest security standards and regulations for post-quantum cryptography.
  • Maintain and enforce robust secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) principles, including side-channel attack resistance, secure coding practices, and cryptographic algorithm agility.

 

🎯 Required Skills And Qualifications

Required:

  • Education: Phd, Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field with a focus on cryptography or cybersecurity.
  • Experience:
  • 10+ years of software development experience, with 5+ years in a leadership role.
  • Strong experience in software security, cryptographic software implementations (e.g., OpenSSL, BoringSSL), and knowledge of post-quantum cryptography.
  • Experience in secure software development and validation, including knowledge of C, C++, Rust, or other relevant languages.
  • Proven experience in bringing secure software products from concept to market.

  • Software Development & Agile Processes: Deep, hands-on experience with modern software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, Kanban), including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and performance metric tracking (e.g., velocity, burn-down charts).
  • Advanced Cryptography: Understanding of cryptographic algorithms, protocols, and key management systems. Familiarity with PQC standards and protocols (e.g., NIST PQC).
  • Security Architecture: Expertise in designing and implementing secure architectures for software and cloud environments.
  • Embedded Systems: Knowledge of secure software for embedded systems and IoT security.
  • Software Security: Experience with software-based security solutions and an understanding of secure coding practices and vulnerability analysis.
  • Secure Implementation: Understanding of the secure implementation of cryptography and systems which use cryptography. Knowledge of Implementation attacks such as Side Channel and Fault injection and implementation countermeasures.

Du hast dein Studium in der Tasche, sprühst vor Energie und willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern echte Verantwortung übernehmen?

Bei Picnic startest du direkt in einer Führungsrolle durch! Als Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d) in unserem teilautomatisierten Fulfillment Center (FC) in Falkensee bist du der Motor des Standorts. Unterstützt von Investoren wie der Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation bauen wir gemeinsam das modernste, 100 % elektrische Liefersystem Europas.

Sei von Anfang an dabei: Im August 2027 eröffnen wir unser neues teilautomatisiertes Fulfillment Center in Falkensee. Du kannst aber schon früher bei uns starten und dein Onboarding an einem unserer bestehenden Standorte absolvieren - zum Beispiel in unserem manuellen Fulfillment Center in Ludwigsfelde oder unserem vollautomatisierten Fulfillment Center in Oberhausen. So bekommst du einen umfassenden Einblick in unsere Operations und bist bestens vorbereitet, wenn wir in Falkensee an den Start gehen.

Das erwartet dich 

  • Teamleitung: Du bist Coach und Vorbild – mit deinem echten, intrinsischen Interesse an Menschen führst und inspirierst du dein Team aus 5 Lead Shoppers und über 150 Shoppers.
  • Schichtleitung: Im FC behältst du stets den Überblick, priorisierst Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass jede Bestellung pünktlich rausgeht.
  • Abwechslung: Du erlebst den perfekten Mix aus Action direkt auf der Lagerfläche (4 Tage pro Woche) und strategischem Deep Dive im FC Office (1 Tag pro Woche).
  • Prozessoptimierung: Stillstand gibt es bei uns nicht. Du hast Ideen? Hier entwickelst du eigene Logistikprojekte und hebst unsere Abläufe durch deinen Tatendrang aufs nächste Level.
  • Ownership: Du hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, auch wenn Dinge mal außerhalb deines unmittelbaren Bereichs liegen. Du schaust über den Tellerrand hinaus und nimmst die Dinge proaktiv selbst in die Hand.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) in Logistikmanagement, Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
  • Du brennst für die Logistik und bringst idealerweise erste Einblicke aus dem Lagerbereich mit (z. B. durch Praktika oder ein Werkstudium).
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch & Englisch und bringst die nötige Flexibilität für die Arbeit in zwei Schichten (6:00 – 14:30 Uhr & 14:30 – 23:00 Uhr, auch samstags) mit.
  • Ein extrem hohes Maß an Eigenantrieb. Du siehst Dinge von selbst, nimmst sie proaktiv in die Hand und übernimmst Verantwortung – auch über deinen eigenen Tellerrand hinaus.
  • Ein echtes, intrinsisches Interesse an Menschen. Du bist empathisch, nahbar und liebst es, dein Team zu motivieren und weiterzuentwickeln.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.
  • Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück, Mittag- und Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Individuelle Mobilität:  Du entscheidest, wie du zu uns kommst. Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und kostenlose Parkplätze an den Picnic Standorten stehen dir zur Verfügung. Dazu bieten wir ein „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm an.
  • Lebensmittelretter: Hol dir unsere exklusiven "Too-Good-To-Go"-Tüten und rette leckere Lebensmittel – nur für unsere Mitarbeitenden!
  • Lerne & wachse: Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.
  • Absicherung für morgen: Wir unterstützen dich mit einem überdurchschnittlichen Zuschuss zur Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, damit du auch an später denkst.

Frontend and Mobile: TypeScript, CSS-in-JS (Styled Components), React, Redux, Redux Hooks, and other modern state management libraries. Kotlin on Android and Swift on iOS. Data: SQL, Python, Snowflake, dbt, Airflow & Looker AI at Marshmallow: Sierra.ai for conversational AI, Python and LangChain for agentic AI solutions, Sagemaker and MLflow for Machine Learning, Cursor and Claude Code for developer productivity. What you'll be doing Drive commercial impact at every turn: Proactively identify and prioritise data science opportunities that offer the highest leverage for the business, ensuring every project is measured by its bottom-line contribution and strategic commercial alignment. Who you are You bring an inherently commercial-first mindset: you don’t just build models, you build solutions that directly influence the P&L, and you constantly evaluate every technical trade-off through a rigorous lens of business value. You have a track record of driving visible improvements to team culture, ways of working, and technical standards. You build trust quickly with a team, and coach others to challenge and disagree constructively, to drive decisions that deliver the highest-impact outcomes You thrive in a fast paced and ever-evolving environment; you adapt to change well (and in fact relish it!). You like to take real ownership of your work, drive yourself forward, and work well both autonomously but also collaboratively with the team and your stakeholders. A strong background as a senior data science individual contributor, with commercial experience delivering ML solutions end to end Proven ability to influence technical direction across Data Science and Engineering, including shaping scalable model/service integration patterns and challenging proposals to drive robust, long-term solutions. Strong stakeholder management skills, with confidence communicating trade-offs and pushing back constructively to C-suite and senior stakeholders across different functions to ensure high-quality outcomes. description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Doctolib est une entreprise B Corp engagée à construire ensemble la santé dont nous rêvons tous. Avec 2 900 collaborateurs en France, en Allemagne, en Italie et aux Pays-Bas, nous accompagnons plus de 420 000 professionnels de santé et 90 millions de patients, transformant l'accès aux soins et la prise en charge à travers l'Europe. Nous accélérons désormais notre ambition : devenir le partenaire clinique de référence en Europe, de confiance pour les patients et les professionnels, grâce à la puissance de technologies avancées et de l'IA.

Notre ambition est de construire le système d'exploitation clinique de demain pour l'Europe - offrant des résultats de santé mesurables pour des millions de personnes.

  • Pour les professionnels de santé : Nous réduisons la charge administrative, augmentons la prise de décision clinique grâce à l'IA et permettons de nouveaux modèles de soins.
  • Pour les patients : Nous passons de soins réactifs en cas de maladie à une gestion proactive de leur santé, en donnant aux personnes les moyens de prendre en charge leur santé avec des compagnons numériques de confiance, recommandés par les médecins.

Vos missions

L'hôpital est l'un des segments les plus stratégiques et exigeants de Doctolib. En une décennie, nous avons construit une présence solide auprès des établissements de santé, publics et privés à but non lucratif, avec une suite complète de solutions couvrant l'ensemble du parcours ambulatoire : visibilité de l'offre de soins, planification, prise de rendez-vous, préparation administrative, assistant de consultation IA, téléconsultation, téléexpertise et bien plus encore.

En tant que Head of Hospitals & Home Care, vous prenez la tête d'une équipe d'une quinzaine de personnes, structurée en acquisition et account management, et appuyée par de nombreuses équipes expertes partenaires, notamment Déploiement, Interopérabilité, Product Marketing et Affaires Publiques. Vous êtes le ou la garant(e) de la performance commerciale, de la satisfaction client et de la vision stratégique du segment hospitalier en France, tout en ouvrant la voie à de nouveaux territoires : le médico-social et les soins à domicile.

Votre responsabilité sera de combiner performance à court terme, développement de la base installée et construction d'une vision stratégique à deux ou trois ans pour le segment.

Vous rejoindrez l'équipe Salaried & Retail France de Doctolib, en reportant à Maric Philibert, notre VP Sales, Salaried & Retail.

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

  • Piloter et atteindre les objectifs de net MRR du segment, sur l'acquisition, l'expansion et la rétention, avec une implication personnelle dans le développement des comptes les plus stratégiques et l'accélération du cross-sell sur les nouvelles solutions, notamment l'Assistant de Consultation et la Téléexpertise.
  • Assurer la satisfaction et l'usage effectif des solutions Doctolib dans les établissements clients, en coordination étroite avec les équipes Déploiement, Interopérabilité et Customer Care.
  • Manager, développer et engager une équipe d'environ 15 personnes, accompagner sa montée en séniorité et renforcer son efficacité grâce à la donnée et aux agents IA.
  • Construire et incarner la vision stratégique à deux ou trois ans du segment, en lien avec la Product Vision de Doctolib et les tendances de marché, en coordination avec les équipes Product Marketing, Affaires Publiques, Communication et Produit.
  • Développer et entretenir les relations institutionnelles clés, notamment avec la FHF, la FEHAP, UNICANCER, la DGOS et les ARS, et piloter les partenariats stratégiques du segment.
  • Explorer et initier les premiers revenus dans les segments médico-social et soins à domicile, en définissant les besoins, la stratégie et les approches tactiques adaptées.
  • Développer une approche structurée de segmentation, d'account planning et de couverture des comptes stratégiques, afin d'augmenter l'adoption, l'expansion, le cross-sell et la rétention.
  • Coordonner les équipes Tech, Déploiement, Legal, Finance, Product Marketing, Affaires Publiques et Partenariats, tout en gardant les priorités clients et terrain au centre des décisions.
  • Représenter Doctolib auprès d'interlocuteurs exécutifs, institutionnels, politiques, techniques et des principaux réseaux professionnels du secteur.

Votre impact

Au cours des 12 premiers mois, vous aurez établi un diagnostic clair et un plan opérationnel pour le segment, renforcé l'équipe et les managers, amélioré la visibilité sur la performance et créé une nouvelle dynamique autour des comptes stratégiques et des opportunités de croissance.

À deux à cinq ans, la réussite se traduira notamment par :

  • Faire progresser le revenu et doubler la croissance en new ARR annuel via l’upsell (licences des solutions historiques), le cross sell (livraison de solutions autour de l’IA et de la coordination des soins) ainsi que l’acquisition de nouveaux clients dans les segments hospitaliers sous-exploités aujourd’hui , le médico-social, les EHPAD et les soins à domicile.
  • Positionner Doctolib comme une solution complète, de confiance et créatrice de valeur pour les établissements de santé, dans une approche plus partenariale et moins transactionnelle, et accompagner les mouvements de fond du secteur : du curatif au préventif, vers plus de coordination entre professionnels de tous types, la responsabilité populationnelle
  • Construire une équipe stable, plus senior et soutenue par les agents IA, donc en capacité de vendre et d’assurer la satisfaction pour plus de solutions et plus d’établissements, moins dépendante des expertises individuelles.

Profil recherché

Nous recherchons un leader senior capable d'agir comme le ou la CEO du segment et d'évoluer avec crédibilité auprès d'interlocuteurs exécutifs internes et externes.

  • Vous justifiez d'une expérience significative auprès d'établissements de santé, acquise comme fournisseur ou prestataire, éditeur e-santé, acteur de la healthtech, dirigeant d'établissement ou de groupe, institutionnel ou consultant en santé avec une forte dimension commerciale. Vous comprenez les acteurs, les personas, les cultures, les rythmes, les circuits de décision et les enjeux politiques et réglementaires du secteur.
  • Vous avez une expérience de la vente B2B complexe et grands comptes, avec des organisations comprenant de nombreuses parties prenantes et des cycles de vente longs. Vous maîtrisez l'acquisition, la vente de solutions complexes, la gestion de comptes stratégiques, l'expansion, l'adoption et la rétention.

description: Hi, I’m Ellie, People Lead at hx. I joined hx in January 2025 as a Senior People Partner and have recently stepped into the People Lead role. Outside of work, I’m an F1 fan and dog mum, so I’m no stranger to fast-paced environments or the occasional pit stop for walkies. Our People team supports all things people at hx, from performance and engagement to the systems, insights and day-to-day operations that help our teams do their best work. We’re growing the team and looking for someone to own our People reporting and analytics, while helping keep the operational side of the function running smoothly. It’s a great opportunity for someone who enjoys turning data into meaningful insights, wants to make a real impact and is excited to help shape how the People team grows alongside the business. Interested? Read more about the role and life at hx below. About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision, helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally, already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure, it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the People team Our People team owns the systems and data that keep hx a high-performance, high-engagement place to work: performance and growth, people analytics, compensation and benefits, and HR compliance. We are building the reporting layer that lets the business make faster, better-evidenced decisions about its people rather than relying on instinct, and we work closely with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data with performance and engagement data so leaders see the full employee lifecycle instead of fragments of it. Inside People and Talent, AI has already changed how we screen, how we write up interviews and how we surface insight to leaders. There is far more to do. Plenty of what we do still runs on manual effort that could be designed out, and this role exists to go after that. We care much more about what you have built and put in front of real users than about the size of the team you have sat in, and impact here isn't tied to title or tenure. You will work directly with People Leaders, with real scope to shape how the team works as we grow. One thing worth being direct about: there is no finished playbook here. If you need a well-defined remit and clear instruction to do your best work, this will be frustrating. If you would rather find the problem yourself and build the fix, you will have a lot of room.. What you'll be doing Build the AI tooling that our People and Talent function runs on. Agents that answer the questions currently landing in our inbox, skills that draft the documents we write manually, workflows that pull our systems together. This is the core of the role rather than a project on the side. Build out the People reporting layer, including dashboards on retention, attrition and engagement, and get to the point where you can tell us what the numbers mean, not just what they are. Work with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data to People data, and make that view something leaders can interrogate themselves. Learn our people processes properly, starting with onboarding, payroll data integrity and the performance cycle, then rebuild the parts that depend on manual effort. Support our performance review cycles in Lattice and our engagement surveys, help analyse what comes out of them, and automate the parts that should not need a person. Help keep our HRIS data accurate, including records, reporting and system troubleshooting. What you'll need to have done Built and shipped something with AI that other people used, whether that is an agent, a script, a tool, a bot or a side project. Got past the first version. We will ask how you tested it, what it got wrong with real users and what you changed as a result. If you have a long list of things you have experimented with, we want to hear what each one taught you. Worked with more than one model or platform, and formed a view on what each is good for. Worked with a real dataset, cleaned it up, and drawn a conclusion you could defend. Been responsible for keeping a system or record accurate, whether that is a tracker, a membership list, a codebase or admin for a part-time role. Handled something that needed to stay confidential, or can show us how you think about handling sensitive information. Genuine interest in how organisations work, and the willingness to learn a domain where the detail matters and the consequences of getting it wrong land on real colleagues. You're unlikely to thrive here if You struggle to adapt to change or ambiguity, or find it difficult to collaborate across diverse teams. You're not energised by a culture that values ownership, feedback, and continuous learning. If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us. Compensation This role sits within a £40,000 - £55,000 salary range. At hx, we're committed to salary transparency, you'll always have clarity on pay early in the process, and our Talent Partner will share more detail with you during initial conversations. We're also working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally. Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make. Once you have effectively concluded the entire recruitment procedure, we will retain your profile and reach out to you once a suitable opportunity emerges. Additional interviews will not be necessary at this stage, and we anticipate being able to extend an offer to you promptly. What does the recruitment process look like? 1. Recruiter Screen In the first call, our recruiter will learn more about you and your story to check a potential fit for gravity9. This is also an opportunity to ask your questions about the role and company. This step might take around 60 mins. 2. Tech 1 Interview with our AI Practice Lead In this meeting your potential future teammate will take a deeper dive into your experience and what you could bring to the team. This step will take around 75 mins. 3. Tech 2 Interview with our software consultants In this meeting your potential future teammate will take a deeper dive into your experience and what you could bring to the team. Thank you for considering the opportunity to be a part of our growing journey. We look forward to the possibility of working together and achieving great things. Role Description gravity9 is expanding its Forward Deployed Engineering team to build production agentic AI systems for enterprise clients, in partnership with leading frontier-model providers. We already support clients from different verticals to have agentic and RAG systems live in production across healthcare, financial services, retail and global logistics. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer you work embedded in the client's environment, from discovery, through architecture and build, to production and handover. This is end-to-end agent engineering, not proofs of concept and not advisory work. Two flavours of engagement: Internal enterprise use cases, such as reconciliation and KYC workflows in financial services, clinical and claims workflows in healthcare, operations and supply-chain workflows in logistics. Product- and customer-facing agents, more greenfield, often exploratory, built into the client's own product. Engagements are typically a team of engineers over a few months, working shoulder-to-shoulder with the client's team including architects, DevOps and QA. Embed with the client. Work hand-in-hand inside the client's environment, codebase and cloud tenancy, often in a hybrid team alongside their engineers. You are visible to the client from day one. Design and build production agentic AI systems. Multi-agent orchestration, tool and function calling, retrieval, planning and routing, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, state and checkpointing, guardrails, failure handling and recovery. Do the unglamorous data work. A large share of every engagement is data engineering: ingestion, flattening deeply nested structures, extracting content from unstructured documents, classification, summarisation, tagging, enrichment, indexing. Models reason over data, bad data beats a good model every time. Own evaluation and accuracy. Establish a baseline eval dataset at the start of the engagement, automate grading, and track groundedness, faithfulness and retrieval quality per tool, not just at the agent level. Be ready to defend accuracy numbers to a sceptical enterprise stakeholder. Engineer for cost and latency. Model selection and routing (cheaper, faster models for non-reasoning steps; frontier models where reasoning genuinely earns it), prompt and context budgeting, caching. Cost is a non-negotiable metric on every engagement. Ship it properly. Observability and tracing, CI/CD, IaC, monitoring the client can actually operate, security and compliance review. Transfer knowledge deliberately. We don't run a long-term support business. Every engagement is designed so the client owns and can extend the system after we leave. You architect with their team in the room, pair with their engineers, and hand over working monitoring and documentation. Technical skills Essential Programming: Strong Python (async, typing, testing, packaging). Working competence in TypeScript / Node is a plus. LLM application engineering: Hands-on production experience with frontier models: prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, tool and function calling, streaming, token and context-window management. Agentic architecture: Built and shipped multi-agent or agentic workflows, planner/router patterns, supervisor and sub-agent designs, ReAct-style loops, state and checkpointing, retries and interrupts, human-in-the-loop review gates. Frameworks: At least one of: Anthropic Agent SDK, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or an equivalent orchestration framework, plus the judgement to know when to use none of them. RAG and retrieval: Chunking strategy, embeddings, hybrid and semantic search, re-ranking, citation and provenance, natural-language-to-query translation. Data platforms: NoSQL databases such as MongoDB (aggregation pipelines, Atlas Search, Atlas Vector Search) or a strong equivalent, plus SQL. Comfortable designing schemas for agent retrieval, not just for OLTP. Data engineering: Building ingestion and enrichment pipelines over messy structured and unstructured sources, documents, PDFs, object storage. Evaluation: Building eval harnesses and eval datasets, LLM-as-judge with its limits understood, regression testing of prompts and agents, metric selection per use case. Cloud: Production delivery on AWS (incl. Bedrock), Azure or GCP, containers, serverless, networking basics, secrets management, IAM. Engineering discipline: Git, code review, testing, CI/CD, IaC (Terraform or equivalent), observability. Strong advantage Anthropic certification (Claude Developer / Anthropic-issued credential), an explicit advantage at shortlisting. Anthropic Agent SDK production experience, a significant bonus. MCP (Model Context Protocol): building servers and clients, tool exposure, auth patterns. Claude Code as an autonomous SDLC agent: sub-agents, hooks, custom skills, agent marketplaces, context sharing across a team. LLM observability and tracing tooling (LangFuse, LangSmith, Arize, Braintrust or similar). Regulated-environment delivery: HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2, FCA/PRA, PII handling, data residency, guardrails and red-teaming. Graph or taxonomy-based knowledge representation alongside vector retrieval. Kafka / streaming, Databricks, or comparable large-scale data platform experience. Nice to have Voice and multimodal agents; evaluation of non-text outputs. FinOps for AI workloads; unit-economics modelling for agent systems. Open-source contribution to the agent / LLM ecosystem, or conference speaking. Prior experience as an FDE, solutions architect, or delivery consultant at a frontier-model, data platform, or infrastructure vendor. Soft skills An FDE is an engineer who is safe in front of a client. We screen as hard on this section as on the technical one. Client presence and credibility. Can hold a technical conversation with a client architect and a business conversation with their CTO or head of operations in the same hour, and be trusted by both. Can present, whiteboard, and answer hard questions without deflecting. Translation. Turns a business problem described by non-technical people such as a clinician, campaign manager or supply-chain planner into a technical design, and explains the technical design back in their language. Ego-free collaboration in a supporting role. On some engagements the tech lead will come from the client or a partner, not from us. You need to contribute strongly, disagree well, and take direction without friction. Brilliant-but-territorial doesn't work here. Comfort with ambiguity and greenfield. Engagements often start before the requirements, the data access, or sometimes the problem statement are settled. You make progress anyway, and you make the ambiguity visible rather than hiding it. Bias to production. Instinctively asks "how does this get deployed, monitored and maintained?" rather than stopping at a working notebook. Teaching instinct. Actively enjoys upskilling the client's engineers, because self-sufficiency at handover is the definition of success, not follow-on billing. Ownership and pace. Short engagements, small teams, no layers to hide behind. You unblock yourself, chase the access request, and follow the thread to the answer. Commercial awareness. Understands that scope, cost and the client's willingness to pay are part of the engineering problem, and contributes to scoping and estimating honestly. Resilience and adaptability. New client, new domain, new stack every few months; occasional travel; occasionally a sceptical stakeholder who has been told AI is coming for their job. You stay steady and constructive. Written communication. Clear design docs, decision records, handover material and status updates in English. Much of this is asynchronous and cross-timezone. Genuine curiosity about the field. This ecosystem changes monthly. We want people who are already reading, building side projects and forming opinions — not waiting for training to be scheduled for them. Experience profile FDE (mid): 3+ years software engineering, 1+ years hands-on LLM / agentic work with at least one system live in production. Client-facing exposure. Senior FDE: 5+ years engineering, 2+ years AI or agentic AI, has owned the architecture of at least one production agent system end-to-end and led a client conversation about it. Lead FDE: 7+ years, has led delivery teams of 3–7 people, can act as engagement tech lead, contributes to pre-sales and estimation, and can mentor a growing FDE bench. What success looks like First 90 days — owning a meaningful component of a client-facing agent system, including its evals, and trusted in front of the client. 6 months — designing agent architectures independently, leading a workstream, and running the handover and knowledge-transfer track. 12 months — a reference point for others on the team, contributing to reusable assets, pre-sales and interviewing. What we offer Support for vendor certifications and access to partner training programmes. Company-wide AI tooling as part of how we work day to day. description: Network Operations Engineer 1. About the role Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure into a single layer and give ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a clean path to deliver connectivity into every home and business across Kenya and the continent. Behind that marketplace is a real network: a BGP edge peering with Tier 1 transit, hyperscalers, and local exchanges, an MPLS backbone, aggregation and access gear, and the systems that watch all of it. For the partners who run on us, the network is the product, and the NOC is where they feel it. A clean shift is a partner who never knew anything happened. That is the bar. We are early and the team is small, so we cannot afford a pair of hands that only knows how to escalate. We need a capable network engineer who can stand a shift, resolve real faults without waking anyone, and then keep building the network while East Africa sleeps: propagation and peering checks, health passes across the estate, config changes through to merge, tickets off the board, automation that takes the next repetitive job off everyone's plate. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling. The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. The point is not to replace your judgment. It is to collapse the time between an alert firing and you knowing where to look, so mean time to repair is measured in minutes. You sit inside that system. In this role, you will own a specific area of expertise, working on sourcing junior data engineers, platform engineers, and alpha researchers to build and maintain trading strategies. You will also be responsible for providing fully featurized datasets to statistical modeling researchers.

HRT does not have information siloes. You will be collaborating directly with our researchers and will be responsible for driving  the business forward through rigorous data analysis and delivery. You will also manage the full end-to-end pipeline from vendor downloads to trading-ready data. As an expert in one area, you will mentor junior data engineers, assisting and validating their work, and will partner with our sourcing team to identify optimal opportunities for data procurement. Furthermore, you will be responsible for ensuring high-quality service by implementing rigorous data checks and alerts.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain fully featurized datasets for statistical modeling research
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for a designated data domain
  • Provide technical support and guidance to researchers on vendor data and derived datasets
  • Mentor and direct junior data engineers, including performing code and data output validation
  • Partner with the sourcing team to identify and evaluate new data procurement opportunities.Analyze data to identify and improve alpha
  • Manage the full end-to-end data pipeline, from raw vendor ingestion to refined feature sets
  • Provide on-call support for data issues during normal business hours
  • Design and implement automated data quality checks and monitoring alerts

Qualifications

  • Strong programming skills (Python/R preferred) and proficiency in data science methodologies
  • 5+ years of professional experience in a specific data domain (e.g., alternative data, fundamentals, security reference, or economic data)
  • Proven track record of building alpha through detailed data analysisExceptional attention to detail
  • Undergraduate degree in a STEM field

This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package.

Culture

description:
About AlphaSense: 

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About Expert Insights:
Expert Insights, which spans AlphaSense’s Expert Transcript Library and 1x1 Call Services offerings,  delivers a new and transformative form of market intelligence content. Through transcripts covering thousands of companies, it captures the unfiltered views and insights of business operators in the trenches, interviewed by professional investors who drill into key questions on what’s truly important about a company at each moment in time. AlphaSense’s library of over 220,000 transcripts is the market’s largest, covering all sectors of the economy, with thousands more published each month. Expert Insights is quickly becoming a table-stakes solution for institutional investors to choose the right companies to invest in while gaining rapid adoption among all other consumers of market intelligence from sell-side research and banking, consultancies, and large corporations.

About the Team:

The Directed Content Team is an integral part of the Expert Insights group, generating thousands of calls each quarter on high-value and strategic content targets - ensuring that the AlphaSense Expert Transcript Library (ETL) delivers comprehensive coverage to our users. The Directed Content team is responsible for identifying, recruiting, and onboarding the best possible experts from around the world based on the targets and topics we are looking to generate content against - ensuring that the interviews with those experts are of the highest-possible quality and relevance.

About the Role: 

As a Sector Lead on our TMT (Technology, Media and Telecoms) Directed Content team, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring AlphaSense delivers the highest-quality proprietary research content within your assigned sector. Reporting to the Director of Research (TMT) you will oversee the day-to-day execution of Directed Content projects, ensuring all work meets the firm’s standards for quality, relevance, and, end-user value delivery. As Sector Lead, you will manage coverage of EMEA and APAC companies.

You will combine operational rigor with sector expertise to oversee a team of Project Managers responsible for generating expert call transcripts across a diverse range of topics within your coverage universe. Your responsibilities will span project setup, expert sourcing guidance, transcript quality assurance, budget oversight, and performance management. Acting as the connective layer between the Director of Research’s strategic vision and day-to-day execution, you will ensure flawless delivery of sector coverage plans while maintaining a pulse on emerging market themes and client information needs.

You will also serve as a key stakeholder in developing and optimizing project workflows, implementing structured QA and feedback loops, and partnering with Product and Operations teams to pilot new AI-enabled tools that elevate both efficiency and insight quality.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Partner with  the Director of Research to develop and maintain a strategic sector roadmap, which you will then translate into a structured execution plan, ensuring coverage aligns with key market and client priorities.
  • Manage and mentor a team of Project Managers that oversee the execution of Directed Content projects, setting clear goals, tracking KPIs, and ensuring accountability across all deliverables.
  • Collaborate with Operations Managers who oversee Analyst execution of expert recruiting, onboarding, and interaction facilitation to align operational KPIs to coverage strategy and optimize execution
  • Own expert budget management for your sector, allocating resources effectively to maximize content ROI while maintaining high quality and throughput.
  • Oversee a structured QA process for ensuring transcripts within your sector of coverage meet the highest standards for data accuracy, relevance, structure, and analytical depth.
  • Collaborate closely with the Director of Research and our Content Strategy Analyst to monitor engagement data, identify coverage gaps, and recalibrate project pipelines accordingly.
  • Collaborate closely with the Director of Research to identify and shape content to support revenue-generating efforts such as white papers, webinars, internal and external presentations.
  • Establish and maintain feedback loops with call takers and project teams to enhance the quality and insight of future content.
  • Collaborate with North America directed content teams to ensure high quality output and consistency.
  • Partner with Operations and Product teams to pilot and optimize AI-enabled tools that improve project throughput, QA precision, and overall efficiency.
  • Maintain deep familiarity with ongoing developments within the Healthcare, TMT or Energy & Industrial sectors, proactively surfacing new themes and companies to guide future research focus.

Who You Are:

  • You have 5–7 years of experience in equity research, market intelligence, consulting, or a related analytical role within TMT
  • You bring deep domain expertise in Technology, Media & Telecoms with a strong grasp of the key players, business models, and industry trends shaping your space.
  • You have a strong understanding of European and Asian equity markets.
  • You have proven people management experience, successfully leading, mentoring, and developing teams of project managers or analysts.
  • You are skilled at translating strategic objectives into actionable research projects that yield high-impact insights.
  • You possess exceptional organizational, analytical, and critical-thinking skills, able to balance multiple priorities with agility while maintaining high quality standards.
  • You have a strong command of project economics, capable of managing budgets, optimizing expert costs, and tracking ROI to ensure resource efficiency.
  • You are adept at working cross-functionally with Directors of Research, Go-to-Market, Product, and Compliance to ensure alignment and continuous improvement.
  • You are intellectually curious, client-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • You maintain a strong understanding of compliance, MNPI, and confidentiality standards across all project types.

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

The role 

Nebius Token Factory needs scientists who can turn frontier inference bottlenecks into research problems, publish credible work, and then help ship the results into production. This is not a papers-only research role. The Applied Scientist is expected to design rigorous experiments, write strong code, collaborate with engineers, and convert research into deployed inference capabilities.

A Senior Applied Scientist owns well-scoped research and production optimization projects. They can publish or prepare high-quality technical work while also producing code, experiments, and prototypes that engineers can use.

Your responsibilities: 

  • Own focused research projects from hypothesis through experiment, ablation, prototype, and production handoff.

  • Prepare internal reports, technical blogs, or papers when the work is externally credible.

  • Partner directly with MLEs to ensure research prototypes become usable production components.

  • Define and execute research programs in efficient LLM and VLM inference with measurable production impact.

  • Invent, evaluate, and productionize methods for quantization, QAT, distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse, KV-cache compression, long-context inference, MoE routing, and model/runtime co-optimization.

  • Build high-quality prototypes in PyTorch, Triton, CUDA-adjacent tooling, or inference-serving frameworks, then work with MLEs and platform engineers to productionize them.

  • Design rigorous evaluation methodology covering quality, latency, throughput, numerical stability, memory footprint, tail latency, and cost per token.

  • Publish papers, technical reports, blog posts, and open-source artifacts that build external credibility for Nebius Token Factory.

  • Collaborate with MLE, GPU kernel, backend infrastructure, product, and customer teams to choose high-leverage research bets.

  • Mentor engineers and scientists on experimental design, scientific rigor, and model/system tradeoffs.

Must-haves: 

  • PhD in computer science, machine learning, ML systems, computer systems, computer architecture, electrical engineering, applied math, or a closely related field.

  • Strong publication record or equivalent research artifacts in ML, ML systems, efficient inference, model compression, quantization, distillation, serving systems, or related areas.

  • Strong hands-on coding ability in Python and PyTorch; ability to move from idea to experiment to prototype quickly.

  • Deep understanding of LLMs, VLMs, transformer inference, decoding algorithms, model compression, quantization, and production-serving tradeoffs.

  • Strong experimental design skills, including ablations, baselines, metrics, statistical reasoning, and failure analysis.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication.

Nice-to-haves: 

  • First-author publications in NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, MLSys, ACL, EMNLP, ASPLOS, OSDI, SOSP, ISCA, HPCA, or comparable venues.

  • Experience deploying ML models or inference optimizations in production.

  • Experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, NVIDIA Dynamo, FlashAttention, FlashInfer, Triton, CUDA, or PyTorch internals.

  • Experience with post-training, SFT, DPO, RLHF, RLAIF, preference optimization, or synthetic data generation when connected to inference quality or efficiency.

  • Open-source research artifacts, widely used benchmarks, high-quality technical blogs, or invited talks in efficient AI systems.

You are an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. Location: hybrid, based at one of our UK offices: London, Cardiff, or Manchester. 

The Role

As a key member of the Global People Operations team, the UK People Operations Coordinator provides end-to-end operational HR support across a diverse UK portfolio. The role has primary employee-lifecycle ownership for Strategy & Communications, People Advisory and Corporate Functions, and coordinates onboarding and offboarding activities for Financial Advisory and Management Consulting. As a first point of contact for employees and managers, the role holder manages a broad range of enquiries, transactions and cases, applying sound judgement, resilience and a strong service mindset. The successful candidate will be a proactive self-starter with HR generalist experience who can build effective stakeholder relationships, manage competing priorities and identify opportunities to simplify and improve how services are delivered. 

Responsibilities 

  • Own and manage the employee lifecycle for Strategy & Communications, People Advisory and Corporate Functions, including onboarding, probation, family leave, absence and wellbeing cases, Visa and immigration, job and contractual changes, internal transfers and offboarding. 
  • Coordinate onboarding and offboarding for Financial Advisory and Management Consulting, ensuring candidates, employees, managers and relevant internal teams understand responsibilities, deadlines and next steps. 
  • Manage business-specific onboarding and offboarding requirements, including different contractual and compensation terms, templates, approvals and downstream actions, while identifying opportunities to align and simplify processes. 
  • Act as a first point of contact for employees and managers, independently resolving a broad range of routine and moderately complex people-related queries. Promote and educate stakeholders on available self-service tools, resources and processes, while providing additional guidance and support where required. Exercise sound judgement in identifying and appropriately escalating sensitive, high-risk or specialist matters to the relevant People Team colleagues.
  • Manage employment changes such as promotions, salary and allowance changes, flexible working arrangements, changes to hours or location, and internal and international transfers, ensuring documentation, approvals and Workday records are complete and accurate. 
  • Prepare contractor agreements and coordinate contractor onboarding and offboarding in Workday. Conduct appropriate checks to support the correct engagement and classification of contingent workers, guide managers through the completion of CEST assessments where required.
  • Provide support, both to employees and the wider People Team, during cyclical process such as Goal Setting, and Performance, Promotion and Compensation reviews. Such support varies by process but may involve leading training sessions for employees, providing Workday assistance, or tracking completion rates.
  • Monitor case queues, lifecycle trackers and deadlines, proactively managing workload, identifying risks and providing clear updates to stakeholders. 
  • Collaborate with Payroll, Reward, HRIS, Recruitment, IT and other internal teams to ensure accurate and timely delivery of employee-lifecycle processes. Route benefits queries to the Reward team and provide operational support where agreed. 
  • Serve as a front-end subject matter expert for Workday and a confident back-end user, providing practical guidance, resolving issues, completing transactions and maintaining high standards of data quality. 
  • Anticipate reporting needs and work with HRIS and other stakeholders to improve reporting, data quality and management information. 
  • Build effective cover arrangements and share knowledge across the UK People Operations team to strengthen resilience during peak periods and absences. 
  • Handle personal and confidential information with integrity, discretion and appropriate data-protection controls. 
  • Proactively contribute to the continuous improvement of HR policies, processes and related documentation/guides to enhance People Operations services and the employee experience.

Requirements

  • At least 2 years’ experience as an HR Generalist
  • Knowledge of local employment legislation.
  • Experience with HRIS systems like Workday preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in human resources, business management, psychology or CIPD Level 3 or 5 qualification is highly regarded
  • Strong administration and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail
  • Exceptional customer service and prioritization skills
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Exemplifies integrity and discretion
  • Continuous improvement mindset – a proactive, adaptable, and agile collaborator.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)

What We Can Offer

  • Competitive salary (depending on experience)
  • 28 days holiday
  • Discretionary bonus
  • Annual salary review
  • Pension (with company contribution: 5% of annual salary)
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave (depending on length of service) and shared parental leave
  • Private medical insurance
  • Group Income protection
  • Life assurance
  • Cycle to work schemes
  • Season ticket loans
  • Regular social, cultural and charitable activities
  • Flexible working with office laptop and phone provided

 

About Teneo

Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future.

Drawing upon our global team and expansive network of senior advisors, we provide advisory services across our five business segments on a stand-alone or fully integrated basis to help our clients solve complex business challenges. Our clients include a significant number of the Fortune 100 and FTSE 100, as well as other corporations, financial institutions and organizations.

Our full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial transactions and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organizational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs, corporate governance and ESG.

The firm has more than 2,000 employees located in 50+ offices around the world.
